snippet.title: Clerks & Quirks - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Clerks & Quirks is a co-op management roguelite where you run your store solo or with up to 4 players, craft iconic items, tame rebellious appliances, and survive the dreaded Friday rush.

A demo is available right now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454860/Clerks_and_Quirks/
